partnershipPlan: Two patient partners from the regional patient council review the plain-language summary for the committee; a surgeon, an anaesthetist and a clinic nurse review the strategy categories.
socialListening: No social media listening; comments to the regional patient advice service about cancelled or delayed surgery are summarised for context.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase (anaesthetist): The bloods are done before I ever meet the patient; I would have to cancel them, not order them.
items.implication: Extract system and default changes as their own strategy.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase (surgeon): If something goes wrong and there was no ECG, it is my name on the form.
items.implication: Report balancing outcomes clearly to address the fear directly.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I assumed the tests were what made the operation safe; nobody said they were optional.
items.implication: Include patient-facing materials as a strategy.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase (clinic nurse): With a clear protocol I can say no to a test; without one I order it to be safe.
items.implication: Extract nurse-led triage as a separate strategy.

summary: Four composite voices on defaults, blame, patient expectations and clinic protocols.
